founder_lenses: CONSUMER: a person arrives in Discord wanting an INSTANT mix. There are exactly two places to make one - the #get-shit-done text channel, and the 2-3 listening (voice) rooms. Judge every change by what that person feels.
FOUNDER: maximum convenience for the user, but ZERO money to spend. At every blockage, reason from first principles about what can be done for FREE.
bundle: Jobs 1-8 from docs/zuko-handoff.md (the approved concurrency batch)
Plus three consumer-lens additions surfaced at kickoff and approved (see decisions below)

decisions.job6_drop_the_wav: SKIP - do NOT build it. Founder's call. A repeat mix currently returns in 0.03s because the full render is kept; in a busy Discord room that instant repeat IS the product. Job 10 (age-based sweep) reclaims the same disk on demand. Revisit only if disk becomes the proven wall.
decisions.resource_failure_behaviour: RETRY QUIETLY AND SAY 'BUSY'. When a grind fails because the MACHINE was out of memory/disk (not because the pair is bad), the app must NOT say 'try another pair' - that blames the user for the host's problem. It re-queues the grind automatically and the card says the grinder is slammed, with a place in line. The user does nothing.
decisions.voice_x64_experiment: YES - attempt it tonight, installing is permitted. Voice is 100% dead on this Windows-ARM machine (no ARM build of the Discord voice audio library), which makes the listening rooms SILENT rooms. Windows 11 on ARM has built-in x86-64 emulation; an x86-64 Python + the Intel wheels may work. Free. Deliver a straight yes/no by morning with evidence.
decisions.the_waiting_card: YES - make the 'grinding...' card MOVE. Today it sits frozen for 25-30s, which reads as broken to a first-timer. It must tick through what is happening, and show queue position ('6th, ~3 min') whenever there is a line.

hard_constraints: DANGEROUS surfaces are STAGED, never self-applied overnight (ZUKO_OVERNIGHT). services/api/app/storage.py is the one in scope tonight (job 10).
storage.py scored 48 = 'human-required' (deletes user audio, irreversible). It is NOT a one-tap card in the morning - it gets a full attended review.
workers/render.py and services/api/app/planner/validate.py must NOT be modified. Nothing tonight changes how a mix SOUNDS.
Never weaken, skip or delete a test to make code pass.
The 0.03s cache hit is a protected product property - no change may regress it.
Free only. No paid service, no cloud spend, no new subscription - the founder has no budget.
